svg.title: Building the action DAG, motion by motion
svg.desc: Animated: ResponseFromTrajectories on a small retrieve. Motions are taken in start-time order; each becomes an ActionNode, is chained to its entity's previous action, depends on every earlier occupant of the space it needs, and then occupies that space. Event edges and two Reduce() passes finish the DAG, which is written out as Schedule.nodes.
svg.metadata: ["Input: CHUGG's trajectories and the event DAG. AGV-2 must leave W22 (event f1). AGV-1 stands under T23 at P23; it lifts (e1), carries the car to bay B21 (e2, three edges), lowers (e3), and the bay hands the car over (e4). AGV-1 waits 3-5 s for AGV-2.", "CollectAndCollapseTrajectoryMotions merges every entity's trajectory into one std::set ordered by MotionScheduleOrder: start time, then the event vertex, then a hash. Waits and idle motions are dropped (AGV-1's wait disappears); runs of floor-traversal motions would be merged into one.", "Motion 1, AGV-2 W22 -> W18 (event f1). ToActionNode makes a0 (TYPE_AGV_COMMAND, fresh guid, job_id = job B). AGV-2 has no previous action. GetBlockers finds nothing. AddOccupant records a0 on every location an entity would collide with: W22, the edge and W18.", "Motion 2, AGV-1 lifts at P23 (event e1). a1 is the first action of AGV-1. lifted is true unless the motion's collision id is the bare AGV. No earlier occupant conflicts with P23; a1 becomes its occupant.", "Motion 3, AGV-1 carries T23 P23 -> W22 (event e2). Chain: a1 -> a2 (last_entity_action[AGV-1]). GetBlockers on the edge P23-W22 returns {a0, a1}: a0 still 'owns' W22, because occupancy is never cleared. New edge a0 -> a2 (blue): the hand-over of W22 from AGV-2 to AGV-1.", "Motion 4, W22 -> W41 (event e2). Chain a2 -> a3. Blockers {a0, a2}: the edge a0 -> a3 is added although a0 -> a2 -> a3 already implies it ('overkill but pruned later by Reduce()').", "Motion 5, W41 -> B21 (event e2). Chain a3 -> a4; blockers {a3}. event_start_end[e2] is now (a2, a4): first and last action of the event.", "Motion 6, AGV-1 lowers T23 in B21 (event e3): a5, chained after a4, blocked by {a4}.", "Motion 7, B21 PROCESS_RETRIEVE (event e4): a6, the bay's first action. No geometric edge orders it after the car's arrival (the code marks bay transitions with a TODO).", "Reduce() keeps only the edges not implied by others: a0 -> a3 goes (a0 -> a2 -> a3 remains).", "TransferEventDagDepsToActionDag: for each event edge e -> e', last action of e -> first action of e'. e3 -> e4 adds a5 -> a6 (amber): the order that only job logic knows. The others (f1 -> e2 as a0 -> a2, e1 -> e2, e2 -> e3) exist already. Reduce() again; no VRC in this layout.", "BuildScheduledActionsArray: one topological order becomes Schedule.nodes. Each in-edge becomes a parent index; the entity's previous action is re-added if Reduce() removed it; each job collects its node_indices. This array is the response."]
